display.purpose: Page-level h1s: exercise titles, index page headline.

headline.purpose: Card/section titles, gate card h2, block titles.

body.purpose: All prose and exercise instructions, capped ~65-75ch.

mono.purpose: Scores, exercise numbers, access codes — anything counted, not read as prose.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: The only elevation step: exercise cards and the gate overlay card.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar fill transition; the only animated property in the system besides color/border on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The 'Corregir todos' call-to-action at the end of an exercise page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #17223B; color: #F3F5F0; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #A8790C; color: #17223B; }

components.name: Channel Button
components.description: Send-results-to-teacher link (WhatsApp/Telegram/Correo/Teams). Always a real <a>, never a scripted window.open().
components.css: .ds-channel-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #ECEEF3; color: #17223B; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.55rem 0.95rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit; } .ds-channel-btn:hover, .ds-channel-btn:focus-visible { background: #D9A441; }

components.name: Exercise Card
components.description: The raised container for one exercise block.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.4rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,34,59,0.06), 0 4px 14px rgba(23,34,59,0.06); }

components.name: Blank Input
components.description: Inline fill-in-the-blank input inside exercise text.
components.css: .ds-input-blank { background: #FCFDFB; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #DCDFD3; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: #17223B; } .ds-input-blank:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #A8790C; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 #A8790C; }

components.name: Results Panel
components.description: Fixed dark-ink surface shown after grading; never follows the page's light/dark theme.
components.css: .ds-results { background: #17223B; color: #ECEEF3; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.6rem; } .ds-results-headline { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-results-score { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: #D9A441; } .ds-results-score span { font-size: 1rem; color: #C7CEDD; }

narrative.overview:
This system is the visual language of a private Spanish tutor's own study materials — not a language-learning product, not a school's LMS. It should read like the table of contents and worksheets of a well-kept, handwritten notebook: cream paper, dark ink, a single gold pencil mark for emphasis. Warmth comes from restraint and craft, not from mascots, streaks, or bright primary colors. Every page in this system — an exercise, an index, a results panel — is a page of the same notebook, so it must share the same paper, the same ink, the same margins.

The system explicitly rejects: gamified language-app aesthetics (badges, streaks, cartoon mascots, saturated primary colors), generic corporate LMS/dashboard chrome (cold grays, dense data tables, stock "education platform" photography), and SaaS-cream minimalism that isn't actually this brand's own palette — the paper tone here is a specific, slightly green-gray cream (#F3F5F0), not a generic warm off-white.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper background, cool dark-navy ink — a stationery pairing, not a screen pairing.
Georgia serif for every heading; a plain system sans for body copy; monospace reserved for numbers.
One accent color (gold) used sparingly — never as a field of color.
The results panel always renders on a fixed dark-ink background regardless of site theme.
Full dark-mode parity on every token, switched by prefers-color-scheme.

rules.name: The Fixed Panel Rule
rules.body: The results panel never uses the swappable --ink/--paper-raised/--gold tokens — it defines its own --rp-* set and stays dark in both light and dark site themes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on at most one or two elements per screen at a time. If gold is filling more than a button or a badge, pull it back.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything read as a count or a code (score, exercise number, access code) renders in monospace; anything read as prose does not.

rules.name: The Two-State Rule
rules.body: An element is either flush with the paper or raised off it with the single shadow. No intermediate elevation step.

dos: Do keep the paper tone a specific cool cream (#F3F5F0), not a generic warm off-white.
Do use Georgia for every heading and the system sans stack for every body paragraph.
Do render scores, exercise numbers, and codes in the monospace stack.
Do give the results panel its own fixed --rp-* dark palette on every new exercise.
Do implement every send-to-teacher channel button as a plain <a target="_blank" rel="noopener">.
Do define both a light and a dark value for every color token.
donts: Don't use gamified language-app styling — mascots, streak counters, bright saturated primary colors, badges.
Don't use generic corporate LMS/dashboard chrome — cold grays, dense data tables, stock photography.
Don't drift the paper background toward a generic warm SaaS-cream.
Don't use window.open() or <button onclick> for any external-link channel button.
Don't point the results panel at the page's shared color tokens.
Don't add a second elevation step or a hard black drop shadow.
